ask: can u make a poll for this
sentence: A shared poll where everyone picks up to three stops for a drive from a short list, and anyone can add another stop, up to six in total.
use_when: a group is choosing where to stop on a road trip
people need to pick a few favorites from a short list
anyone in the chat should be able to suggest extra options
a quick look at which stops have the most votes
dont_use_when: a single-choice vote or yes/no question is needed
the group needs to plan a route or schedule with times
costs or expenses need to be split between people
